card.title: Practice with AI
card.desc: Chat with a tutor about the lesson. Answer by voice or text and get feedback tied to the video after every answer.

intro.heading: Chat with a tutor about this lesson
intro.desc: The tutor asks about the characters and events in the video. You answer in English, the tutor checks your answer against the transcript and asks the next question.
intro.ruleTime: Up to 15 minutes, then the tutor wraps up
intro.ruleCredit: Each tutor turn costs credits based on its real cost; hints and reviewing history are free
intro.ruleWatch: Watch the video once before you start
intro.starting: The tutor is preparing the first question…

resume.heading: You have an unfinished conversation
resume.restartNote: The old conversation stays in your history.

bar.question: Question {{n}}/{{max}}
bar.finishNeedAnswer: Answer at least one question before finishing

thread.better: A more natural way to say it

answer.label: Your answer
answer.tooShort: That recording was too short, speak a little longer.
answer.micDenied: Can't use the microphone. Allow microphone access or type your answer.

summary.title: Overall feedback
summary.expired: The 15 minutes are up, so the tutor wrapped up the conversation.
summary.stopped: This conversation stopped midway, so it has no overall feedback.
summary.failed: The overall feedback could not be created.

history.title: Conversation history
history.empty: You have no conversations for this lesson yet.
history.reviewing: You are reviewing an old conversation (read only, no credits used).

video.title: Rewatch the video
video.hint: The transcript is hidden so you answer on your own.

errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You don't have enough credits to start. Free credits refresh tomorrow; Pro credits refresh in your next plan month.
errors.AI_CHAT_NO_SPEECH: No speech was heard in the recording. Record again; this answer was not counted.
errors.AI_CHAT_ANSWER_INVALID: An answer needs 1 to 1000 characters, or a recording of 0.5 to 30 seconds.
errors.AI_FEEDBACK_BUSY: The AI is busy, try again in a few minutes. No credits were used.
errors.AI_FEEDBACK_UNAVAILABLE: The tutor is temporarily unavailable. No credits were used, please try again later.
errors.AI_CHAT_TURN_CONFLICT: This question was just answered elsewhere. The conversation was reloaded.
errors.AI_CHAT_FINISH_TOO_EARLY: Answer at least one question before finishing.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong, please try again.
